summary: CLINUVEL Pharmaceuticals furnished a Form 6-K attaching an ASX announcement dated 30 October 2026 disclosing that it filed a marketing-authorisation dossier for NEURACTHEL Instant (tetracosactide, a branded generic ACTH analogue) with national European regulators under the EU decentralised procedure, targeting up to three initial Member States. No price, stake or capital event is involved. The DCP review is nominally 300 days excluding clock stops, with a day-270 position; further UK MHRA and US FDA submissions are under evaluation. NEURACTHEL Instant is not yet approved anywhere. This is a routine product-regulatory update; no deal or corporate action to arbitrage.
